label: City of Calgary
note: Calgary requires its Request for Specific Variance form (R2014-06), tied to a building permit. Completeness screening only.

checks.label: Building permit number
checks.why: A variance request can only be accepted if a building permit has been applied for; a variance number cannot be issued without a building permit number.

checks.label: This request covers one issue only (separate form for each different issue)
checks.why: A separate form must be submitted for each different issue; several articles may sit under one request if they concern the same issue.
checks.prompt: Does this request deal with a single issue?

checks.label: Need for a variance discussed with a safety codes officer in the building discipline
checks.why: Step 1 of the guide: discuss the need for a variance with an SCO first.
checks.prompt: Have you discussed this with an SCO?

checks.label: Code, standard and sections being varied
checks.why: Details of variance: indicate what code, standard and sections are varied, and quote from the provision.

checks.label: Description of the project the variance applies to
checks.why: Details of variance: provide a description of the project.

checks.label: Description of the work done under the variance
checks.why: Details of variance: describe the work that will be done under the variance.

checks.label: Effect, if any, on other NBC(AE) requirements
checks.why: Details of variance: describe what effect, if any, the work will have on other NBC-AE requirements.
checks.prompt: Have you described the effect on other NBC(AE) requirements (or stated none)?

checks.label: Function and objective statements for the articles varied
checks.why: Details of variance: provide the function and objective statements associated with the articles you are seeking to vary.

checks.label: Conditions, if applicable
checks.why: Details of variance: include any conditions if applicable.
checks.prompt: Have you listed any conditions (or confirmed none apply)?

checks.label: Rationale why the alternative should be accepted instead of the Division B prescriptive requirements
checks.why: Reason for Variance: rationale for the alternative method and how it achieves as good or better performance.

checks.label: Supporting evidence for the rationale, naming attached documents
checks.why: Reason for Variance: supporting evidence; refer to attached documents by name and date issued.

checks.label: Supporting documents stamped and sealed where a professional is required
checks.why: If a professional is required for the work, the supporting documents must also be stamped and sealed.

checks.label: Calgary Building Advisories have no legal status
checks.why: Advisory Bulletins have no legal status and cannot be used as an official interpretation of codes and regulations; treat them as background only.
